purpose: Allow SARA Lite OS to request tightly governed schema, map, and policy evolution through CONTROL-Lite, SECURITY-Lite, and NBS-Lite without introducing raw execution, shell access, socket access, or URL access.

governance_model.state_engine: NBS-Lite for delta application and continuity
governance_model.sdk_role: SDK-Lite request builder only; never execution authority

sdk_lite_builder.description: SDK-Lite constructs the request record and forwards it into CONTROL-Lite. It never applies deltas or executes changes directly.
requirements: Build the canonical JSON request for protocol='sara_self_evolve'.
Populate correlation_id, machine_profile, and evolve_request deterministically.
Allow scope only from the bounded set ['schemas', 'maps', 'policies'].
Default dry_run to true on all first-pass requests.
Reject or omit any field that implies shell execution, sockets, URL fetch, or arbitrary code execution.
forbidden_behaviors: direct file mutation outside NBS-governed delta staging

control_lite_governance.description: CONTROL-Lite accepts routing_intent='self.evolve', verifies the caller identity, and routes the request to SECURITY-Lite plus NBS-Lite under a dry-run-first policy.
requirements: Accept routing_intent='self.evolve' as a first-class governed route.
Verify that origin and target represent a trusted SARA node such as 'sara-lite-os'.
Require machine_profile.node_id and machine_profile.environment before continuing.
Route the request first to SECURITY-Lite for approval and then to NBS-Lite for dry-run evaluation.
Enforce dry_run=true on the first pass even if the caller attempts otherwise.
Return 'blocked' or 'dry_run_ok' status rather than implicit execution when any condition is uncertain.
deterministic_rules: No free-form execution verbs are allowed.
No scope may extend beyond schemas, maps, and policies.
All responses must retain the original correlation_id.
Initial pass never applies live changes without a validated dry run.

security_lite_requirements.description: SECURITY-Lite validates trust, signatures, and environment policy before any NBS-Lite evolution can proceed.
requirements: Verify signatures on all referenced deltas when require_signed=true.
Verify node identity from machine_profile.node_id.
Verify environment trust against local_only, lan, or internet policy.
Block the request if evolution is forbidden in the current environment or trust tier.
Block the request if any delta attempts to weaken CONTROL-only routing or SECURITY-first gating.
Audit all attempts with correlation_id, node identity, scope, and final decision.

nbs_lite_requirements.description: NBS-Lite stages, validates, dry-runs, snapshots, and if later approved applies only the allowed delta classes.
requirements: Apply deltas only to schemas, maps, and policies.
Never apply code execution payloads, binaries, shell commands, or network actions.
Write a continuity snapshot before the dry run begins.
Write another continuity snapshot after a successful dry run or after a later approved apply pass.
Refuse any delta that weakens CONTROL-only routing or SECURITY-first gating.
Keep last-known-good state available for rollback at all times.
forbidden_delta_classes: policy changes that bypass control or security

mama_lite_requirements.description: MAMA-Lite explains the request and result in plain language for the operator without ever gaining authority over routing or execution.
requirements: Emit human-readable summaries of dry-run results, blocked attempts, and approved apply outcomes.
Present operator_action_suggested in low-strain language.
Use ADA-friendly, low-click, reduced-cognitive-load output formatting.
Never gain routing or execution authority.
Never mutate NBS state directly.
sample_summary_outputs: Dry run completed successfully; review proposed schema and policy changes before confirmation.
Evolution request blocked because the environment trust policy does not allow self-evolution in this mode.
Approved changes were applied to schemas and maps; reboot not required.

service_flow: CONTROL-Lite normalizes and verifies self.evolve intent
SECURITY-Lite validates signatures, node identity, and environment policy
NBS-Lite performs dry run and continuity snapshotting
A later approved pass may move from dry_run_ok to applied if policy and operator controls allow it

safety_constraints: No raw execution, shell access, socket access, or URL access may be introduced by this protocol.
All behavior must remain deterministic, NBS-driven, and CONTROL/SECURITY-governed.
Dry run is mandatory on the first pass.
The protocol may evolve only schemas, maps, and policies.
Neither CONTROL-only routing nor SECURITY-first gating may be weakened by any accepted delta.
If any check fails, the request result must be 'blocked' and the platform remains in a safe posture.

rollout_guidance.phase_1: Define the canonical schema and route binding for routing_intent='self.evolve'.
rollout_guidance.phase_2: Add SECURITY-Lite signature and environment checks plus NBS-Lite dry-run validation.
rollout_guidance.phase_3: Add operator-facing MAMA-Lite summaries and cockpit visibility for review and confirmation.
rollout_guidance.phase_4: Allow controlled 'applied' mode only after dry-run and trust-policy approval are both satisfied.
